questionText: During classroom activities, several behaviours were noticed. Which of these behaviours showed lack of good manners?
options: Interrupting someone while they are speaking
Greeting teachers politely when they arrive
Saying please and thank you when requesting for help
Waiting patiently for your turn during a discussion
explanation: Interrupting someone while they are speaking is a sign of bad manners[cite: 191].

questionText: Which of the following is the best way a student can use leisure?
explanation: Acquiring new skills is a productive and beneficial way to spend leisure time[cite: 191].

questionText: Which of these drugs is commonly abused by individuals?
explanation: Heroin is an illicit substance frequently associated with severe drug abuse[cite: 191].

questionText: Communities celebrate festivals for many reasons. Which one of these does not align with the reason for which your community celebrates its festivals?
options: Giving thanks to the gods for favours received
Comparing the achievements of the living and the dead
Planning for developmental projects in the community
explanation: Festivals are not meant for comparing achievements of the living and the dead[cite: 191].

questionText: During a school festival, students from different religions were tasked to plan a presentation. Which approach would best demonstrate religious tolerance in this case?
options: Assigning mixed religion groups to encourage collaboration
Allowing students to form their own groups
Letting only students of one religion lead the festival
Separating students strictly by religion for all activities
explanation: Assigning mixed religion groups promotes collaboration and mutual religious tolerance[cite: 191].

questionText: In order to promote peaceful co-existence among members of different religions, there is the need to
options: report activities of other religions to your religious authority.
be tolerant of each other's beliefs.
bear witness of your beliefs to other people.
explanation: Tolerance of each other's beliefs is vital for peaceful religious co-existence[cite: 191].

questionText: Kwame took his friend's pen without asking and later realized that what he did was wrong. What should he do as the first step if he wants to make things right?
options: Ask his teacher to punish him
Buy a new pen for his friend
Promise his friend he would never repeat his mistake
explanation: Admitting one's fault is the essential first step toward making amends[cite: 191].

questionText: A parent wants to give their new born baby a name. What factor should they consider the most important?
options: The place of birth of the baby
explanation: Parents' tribe and cultural background heavily influence traditional naming systems[cite: 191].

questionText: Fatima wants to learn how Prophet Muhammed (SAW) prayed and behaved in his daily life. Which source should she study?
explanation: The Sunnah details the practical lifestyle, practices, and behaviors of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)[cite: 191].

questionText: Which of the following traditional leaders saved his people from the hands of a wicked king?
explanation: Togbe Tsali is traditionally noted for using his spiritual powers to save his people from a wicked king[cite: 191].

questionText: What quality did Joseph display when he welcomed his brothers after many years?
explanation: Joseph demonstrated deep forgiveness by welcoming his brothers despite their past betrayal[cite: 191].

questionText: A teacher explains that God's titles help people to understand who He is. Which of these actions shows how this knowledge can be applied?
explanation: Understanding God's attributes leads believers to offer prayers and glorify Him[cite: 191].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Attributes of God)

questionText: Which of these actions best reflects Yaa Asantewaa's leadership qualities?
options: Leading a group to challenge unfair treatment collectively
Helping individuals to navigate difficulties on their own
Suggesting improvements without coordinating with others
Writing about fairness and justice in a school publication
explanation: Yaa Asantewaa demonstrated bold, collective leadership in challenging colonial injustice[cite: 191, 192].

questionText: A friend wants to start a program to help the less privileged in his community. How can she apply Khadijah's example?
options: mentoring the children while supporting the programme
encouraging others to participate and contribute actively
offering both moral and material support to the initiative
organizing resources and planning the programme effectively
explanation: Khadijah is celebrated for offering substantial moral and material support to noble causes[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Early Islamic Figures)

questionText: In a traditional society, certain rules are made to control the behaviour of members. Which of the following best describe these prohibitions?
options: Rules that are meant for only visitors
Ideas that are meant for only leaders
Rules that stop people from doing wrong
Suggestions for things people might like to do
explanation: Taboos and prohibitions serve as moral guardrails to prevent people from doing wrong[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Taboos & Moral Rules)

questionText: Which of the following is believed to be the most important part of performing Muslim prayer (Salat)?
explanation: Ablution (Wudu) is an indispensable ritual purification required before performing Salat[cite: 192].

questionText: Which of the following explanations best justifies the fact that low self-esteem can lead to drug abuse?
options: can increase vulnerability to negative influences.
explanation: Low self-esteem makes individuals more vulnerable to negative peer pressure and bad influences[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Self-Esteem & Drug Abuse)

questionText: The family system in every society is functional in the following ways except
explanation: The institution of a formal reward system is not a core functional role of the family structure[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (The Family System)

questionText: Mr Ansah pays part of his salary into a fund every month. Which benefit is he most likely to gain making this contribution after retirement?
explanation: Regular contributions to social security provide reliable financial security upon retirement[cite: 192].

questionText: The Bible teaches that God created the sun, moon and stars for specific purposes. Which of the following is not one of the purposes?
options: serve as objects of human worship
explanation: Creation is meant to be admired and used, but not served as objects of human worship[cite: 192].

questionText: Yaw was warned not to make noise during lessons but he ignored the warning. He was punished as a result. Why was this punishment necessary?
options: embarrassed him in front of others.
made the student fear the teacher.
showed that the teacher has authority.
explanation: Classroom discipline and punishment serve to deter others from repeating similar infractions[cite: 192].

questionText: Which of these values can be inferred from the parable of the lost coin?
options: Hard work always leads to prosperity.
Material possessions are more important than relationships.
Wealth should be carefully accumulated and protected.
explanation: The parable highlights how much value God places on every single individual[cite: 192].

questionText: Abu is asked to give money to influence a clerk so he can get his results early but he refused. Which moral value is Abu demonstrating?
explanation: Refusing bribery and standing by moral principles demonstrates high integrity[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Moral Values - Integrity)

questionText: The Ewe name for God 'Mawu' signifies His being mighty. Which of these actions best explains how this understanding can influence the way people relate to God?
explanation: Recognizing God's ultimate might causes believers to approach Him with deep reverence[cite: 192].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Names of God)

questionText: At a traffic junction, motorists were entreated to obey the traffic police. Why is obeying authority important in this situation?
options: allows drivers more room to operate.
stops people from driving at night.
explanation: Obeying traffic regulations and officers ensures public safety on the roads[cite: 192].

questionText: The following factors are causes of corruption in Ghana except
explanation: Suicidal tendencies are a mental health issue and not a direct cause of societal corruption[cite: 192].

questionText: Ama always greets politely, listens attentively to classmates and waits patiently for her turn to speak. This behaviour best demonstrates
explanation: Polite greetings, attentive listening, and patience reflect good courtesy[cite: 192, 193].

questionText: Aku wants to buy a bag which is on top of her list, a pencil case and some snacks but her money is not enough to buy everything. What budgeting principles would she be practising if she decides to buy the bag?
explanation: Choosing the most important item when resources are limited is the principle of prioritizing[cite: 193].

questionText: Kwame receives 50 cedis as allowance. He decides to keep it safely in his wallet instead of spending it immediately so that he can buy a school bag later. Which characteristic of money is being illustrated here?
explanation: Saving money for future use illustrates its function as a store of value[cite: 193].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Characteristics of Money)

questionText: In which of the following ways does protecting forest reserves reflect human's responsibility to God's creation?
options: Ensuring the survival of the biosphere
Allowing unrestricted logging to support economic growth
Replacing natural forest with commercial plantation
explanation: Protecting forests ensures environmental balance and the survival of the wider biosphere[cite: 193].

questionText: Mr and Mrs Akoto often disagree on how to spend money at home. Sometimes, the argument becomes toxic and it is beginning to break their marriage. Which of the following actions do you think can best help them to have a peaceful home?
options: Allowing only one person to make decision on money
Complaining to neighbours about the issue
Sharing ideas and making decisions together
explanation: Sharing financial ideas and making joint decisions promotes peace and understanding in a marriage[cite: 193, 198].

questionText: Kojo who is fourteen years old has become rebellious and arrogant towards his parents and peers. What may be the possible cause of his behaviour?
options: going through physical changes at puberty.
explanation: Adolescent behavioral shifts are often linked to emotional and psychological changes during puberty[cite: 193].

questionText: People enjoy religious songs for various reasons. Which of these best explains why these songs are meaningful to believers?
options: help them to put the world behind.
explanation: Religious songs deeply connect believers to their spiritual faith and devotion[cite: 193].

questionText: Amina noticed that students in her school often felt hungry after class. She decided to start selling healthy snacks. Which entrepreneurial skill is Amina applying?
explanation: Recognizing a gap or need and filling it demonstrates opportunity identification[cite: 193].

questionText: Your classmate, Yaw, is always the first to come to school. On days that he is not the first, he tries not to miss school. Which attitude to work is Yaw practising?
explanation: Consistent early arrival at school exemplifies punctuality[cite: 193].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Work Ethics - Punctuality)

questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of the extended family over the nuclear family system?
options: ensures that all family members live in the same house.
allows family members to share responsibilities.
makes parents less responsible for their children.
prevents conflicts from happening in the family.
explanation: The extended family network allows members to share financial, social, and domestic responsibilities[cite: 193].

questionText: A Muslim community wants to honour a deceased member, which of these actions would reflect their traditional practice?
explanation: Offering the funeral prayer (Janazah) is the standard Islamic communal practice for honoring a deceased Muslim[cite: 193].
topic: Religious and Moral Education (Islamic Funeral Rites)

questionText: A school is having a challenge in deciding on an activity that would best reflect the key value of Idul-Adha. Which of these activities would you recommend?
options: Preparing cultural display and traditional meals for celebration
Inviting parents and community members to celebrate with students
Organizing special prayers to mark the festivals
Organizing a seminar on obedience, sacrifice and generosity
explanation: Idul-Adha core values revolve around obedience to God, supreme sacrifice, and generosity[cite: 193].

questionText: According to the creation story, God separated the waters from the waters. What does this separation refer to?
explanation: Biblical creation accounts describe the separation between the waters above (sky) and waters below (seas)[cite: 193, 198].

questionText: During libation, why do the traditional worshippers address their prayers to the ancestor?
explanation: Ancestors are revered as intermediaries who are closer to God and the divinities[cite: 193, 198].
